title: He won the Olympic marathon barefoot (Part 1)
description:
Rome, 1960. Abebe Bikila - a captain in Emperor Haile Selassie's Imperial Guard - ran the Olympic marathon barefoot after his new shoes caused blisters. At night, by torchlight, over cobblestones, past the Axum obelisk Mussolini's army had looted from Ethiopia, he broke the world record: 2:15:16.2. Ethiopia's first Olympic champion in history.
Part 2 - the Tokyo comeback and what came after - is on the channel.
